scripts.build: next build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const expDir=p.resolve('.next/export');const det=p.resolve('.next/export-detail.json');if(!fs.existsSync(det)){fs.mkdirSync(expDir,{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(p.join(expDir,'404.html'),'<!DOCTYPE html><html lang=zh-CN><head><meta charset=utf-8><title>404</title><meta http-equiv=refresh content=0;url=/></head><body></body></html>');fs.writeFileSync(det,JSON.stringify({version:0,success:true,outDirectory:expDir}))}"
